newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise sells French units to Swiss Life.
newsitem.headline: Baloise sells French units to Swiss Life.

text.p: Swiss-based Baloise Insurance Group said that it was selling its French life and non-life units to Swiss Life.
In a separate statement, Swiss Life confirmed the transaction, saying a letter of intent was signed on June 26, 1997. The acqusition still requires due diligence and approval of French regulators.

Neither firm gave a price for the transaction. Baloise said the move was in keeping with its objectives announced in December, when it said it would pull out of some markets including France to concentrate on others where it has a stronger presence.
In France, La Baloise (France) and La Baloise Vie Succursale were slated for sale.
The combined premium volume is greater than 235 million Swiss francs, or 940 million French francs, Baloise said.
Swiss Life said that the newly acquired portfolios would be integrated into La Suisse Assurances (France) and La Suisse Assurances-vie.
